row.reason: Crexendo sells cloud business phone (UCaaS), meetings and contact center subscriptions mainly to small and mid-sized businesses. Amdocs sells BSS/OSS billing, CRM and network software, plus managed services, to large telecom, cable and media operators. The products differ: end-user communications service versus carrier back-office software. The business models also differ: recurring seat subscriptions versus enterprise licences, integration projects and multi-year managed services. Crexendo's white-label licensees give only a thin customer overlap with telecom providers.
